items.title: Andy Jassy 称 AWS 将成为万亿美元营收业务，2026 年资本开支约 2200 亿美元
items.summary: 亚马逊财报电话会上，CEO Andy Jassy 重申 AWS 可在未来五到十年成为万亿美元年营收业务，预计 2026 年现金资本开支约 2200 亿美元，其中大部分投向 AWS，2027 年还将大幅增加。AWS 当季营收同比增长 39%，年化营收运行率达 1840 亿美元，Jassy 预测 2027 和 2028 年增速均可超 40%；财报后盘后交易中亚马逊股价下跌约 6%。
items.title_original: AWS will be a $1T business, Jassy says. But first, it will spend big.

items.recommend_reason_zh: Jassy 称 AWS 将成为 1 万亿美元业务，并让 Amazon 成为首家 1 万亿美元营收公司，但前提是继续大举资本开支。

en.summary: On Amazon’s earnings call, CEO Andy Jassy reiterated that AWS can become a trillion-dollar annual revenue business within five to ten years. He expects about $220 billion in cash capex in 2026, most of it going to AWS, with a substantial increase again in 2027. AWS revenue grew 39% year over year in the quarter, with an annualized run rate of $184 billion, and Jassy expects growth to exceed 40% in both 2027 and 2028. Amazon shares fell about 6% in after-hours trading following the report.
en.reason: Andy Jassy says AWS can become a $1 trillion annual-revenue business in five to ten years, while Amazon plans about $220 billion in 2026 cash capex, mostly for AWS, after AWS grew 39% to a $184 billion run rate.

items.title: Reddit 宣布转向以登录为主的体验，以应对 AI 搜索带来的流量下滑
items.summary: Reddit 在 Q3 财报中宣布将转向以登录为主的体验，以保护数据免受 AI 抓取并提升广告变现。10 月搜索流量平均每周减少超 100 万次引荐，Q3 全球日活为 1.303 亿，其中美国日活降至 5070 万，同比降 2%。Q3 收入同比增长 53% 至 8.95 亿美元，净利润 2.83 亿美元；该转变将先在美国以外市场测试，暂无全球上线时间表。
items.title_original: As search traffic dries up, Reddit announces it’s shifting to a logged-in experience
items.title_en: As search traffic dries up, Reddit announces it’s shifting to a logged-in experience

items.title_bilingual: Reddit 宣布转向以登录为主的体验，以应对 AI 搜索带来的流量下滑 / As search traffic dries up, Reddit announces it’s shifting to a logged-in experience
items.recommend_reason_zh: 这篇报道解释了 Reddit 为何在搜索流量枯竭、AI 改变人们在线找信息方式的背景下宣布转向 logged-in experience，并重新思考开放网络根基以保护受众和业务。

en.summary: Reddit announced in its Q3 earnings that it will shift to a login-first experience to protect its data from AI scraping and improve ad monetization. In October, search traffic averaged more than 1 million fewer referrals per week; Q3 global daily active users were 130.3 million, with US DAUs falling to 50.7 million, down 2% year over year. Q3 revenue rose 53% year over year to $895 million, with net income of $283 million; the shift will first be tested in markets outside the US, with no global rollout timeline yet.
en.reason: Reddit will test a logged-in experience outside the U.S. first to block AI scraping and boost ad monetization after October search referrals fell by more than 1 million weekly, even as Q3 revenue rose 53% to $895 million.

en.title: AI Infra Deep Dive: Understanding Linear Attention Mechanisms in 30,000 Words

en.summary:
Chainguard releases two beta products for running and testing code written by developers and AI agents.
Chainguard releases two beta products for running and testing code written by developers and AI agents.
Word count: 1,856
Reading time: about 6 minutes
Chainguard is rolling out Workspaces and Checks, two beta products that provide isolated remote development environments and lightweight CI capabilities, respectively, designed for securely running code from developers and AI agents.
Workspaces is built on hardened microVMs and supports syncing uncommitted code, session snapshots and multi-instance isolation; Checks embeds CI into the development flow, avoiding traditional CI queue congestion and repeated dependency downloads. Together they address the fundamental tension between agent execution privileges and the exposure of enterprise assets.
Suited for platform engineers, DevSecOps engineers and AI engineering teams.

en.title: I've been watching AI trading tools for over a year now. Most products are all competing on the same things: how many markets they connect to, how many models they can run, whose strategy is better. But I've come to believe the bottleneck isn't there. It's the five minutes after someone first opens the product — they don't know what to do, they close it, and they never come back. @questflow recently rebuilt its entire interface. What made me stop this time wasn't something new it added — it's that it's reworking those five minutes. // After new users finish onboarding, they can immediately create their first Agent. No watching a tutorial first, no connecting a wallet first, no picking a model first — just create one: monitor market moves…
en.reason: Questflow’s redesign lets new users create their first Agent immediately after onboarding—no tutorial, wallet binding or model selection first—tasking it to monitor market moves and push breaking news within a chosen scope.

en.title: AI EDA enters its validation phase, bringing three changes across the industry chain. EDA (chip design automation software) is evolving from a "tool" into an "agent": AI EDA uses AI agents to take over the time-consuming "design—verify—modify" loop in chip design, and AI EDA has now entered its validation phase.
en.reason: Synopsys has mapped AI EDA onto an autonomous-driving-style L1–L5 scale and this year demonstrated L3–L4 multi-agent workflows spanning natural-language RTL generation and automated verification convergence, with measured efficiency gains of several times, as the piece maps the industry's three shifts from point tools to agent platforms.

en.title: Chainguard launches secure workspaces and security verification for AI coding agents
en.summary:
Chainguard releases two beta products for running and testing code written by developers and AI agents.
Chainguard releases two beta products for running and testing code written by developers and AI agents.
Word count: 1,856
Reading time: about 6 minutes
Chainguard is rolling out Workspaces and Checks, two beta products that provide isolated remote development environments and lightweight CI capabilities, respectively, designed for securely running code from developers and AI agents.
Workspaces is built on hardened microVMs and supports syncing uncommitted code, session snapshots and multi-instance isolation; Checks embeds CI into the development flow, avoiding traditional CI queue congestion and repeated dependency downloads. Together they address the fundamental tension between agent execution privileges and the exposure of enterprise assets.
Suited for platform engineers, DevSecOps engineers and AI engineering teams.
Software supply chain security company Chainguard has released two beta products for running and testing code written by developers and AI agents. Chainguard Workspaces offers remote development environments built on hardened microVMs, while Chainguard Checks brings continuous integration into the development workflow. en.reason: Chainguard's beta Workspaces isolate AI coding agents in hardened microVMs while Checks embeds CI into the development flow and produces signed attestations bound to a commit SHA.

en.title: I've been watching AI trading tools for over a year now. Most products are all competing on the same things: how many markets they connect to, how many models they can run, whose strategy is better. But I've come to believe the bottleneck isn't there. It's the five minutes after someone first opens the product — they don't know what to do, they close it, and they never come back. @questflow recently rebuilt its entire interface. What made me stop this time wasn't something new it added — it's that it's reworking those five minutes. // After new users finish onboarding, they can immediately create their first Agent. No watching a tutorial first, no connecting a wallet first, no picking a model first — just create one: monitor market moves…
en.reason: Questflow’s redesign lets new users create their first Agent immediately after onboarding—no tutorial, wallet binding or model selection first—tasking it to monitor market moves and push breaking news within a chosen scope.
